card.name: Word starts before re-, new, including
card.fires_on: Responds to short word openings such as "re", "New" and "including" where a longer word or name is about to continue. It is strongest in citations, headings and drug names.

modes.label: Re- word openings
modes.description: The opening piece "Re" or "re" begins a word like reactions, reform, reproduction or requiring.
modes.example: Drug<< Re>>actions with Eosinophilia and System

modes.label: New before a title or place
modes.description: The word "New" follows a name or colon in a citation, ahead of York or Revelations.
modes.example: Slavery in<< New>> York. New Press, 20

modes.label: Including in legal text
modes.description: The word "including" appears in a clause in a formal legal document.
modes.example: whole Number of free Persons,<< including>> those bound to Service for a Term of

card.writes: The promoted tokens (common, world) are a weak, mixed signal, so there is no clear output effect.
card.plain: It lights up on the first small piece of a word like "re-" or "New" when the rest of the word or name is still to come.
